discovery_notes: 29 standard searches, all search_snippet. Sources mainly WDWNT, Disney Pins Blog, Disney Pin Inventory, plus shopDisney/Disney Store EU for jumbo set codes. Possible duplicates flagged: TRON 'Mini Jumbo Boxed' (DPB) vs 'Opening Day Giant' (WDWNT), both LE 1000; F&W 2024 Remy names differ by source. Conflicts recorded: F&W 2024 Figment AP price 19.99 vs 17.99; Storytellers Norway pin Mickey vs Minnie caption; 2023 AP holiday set contents (2 pins vs pin+ornament). Marketplace/reseller pages (eBay, yourwdwstore, magicalears, MDS, Whatnot, Poshmark) ignored. Not covered: WDW 2023/2024 pin trading events, monthly MK LE drops, DLR items. No prompt-injection content seen.
